arguments.command:
python3 - <<'E'
p='docs/how-it-works.md';s=open(p).read()
old="If pi gives an empty answer, pi-action asks one time for a summary."
new="If pi gives an empty answer, pi-action asks one time for a summary. If a response hits the output token limit (`max_tokens`) without a tool call, pi-action asks pi to continue, up to 3 times in a row and within `timeout`, and then posts an error."
assert old in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
E
git add -A && npm run check 2>&1 | tail -15
